display_title: Lionel Messi Continues Historic Scoring Streak
display_title_he: ליאו מסי ממשיך ברצף הכיבושים ההיסטורי שלו
short_summary: At 39, Lionel Messi continues to dominate the MLS, reaching 936 career goals after a stellar performance for Inter Miami.

sources.name: Walla
sources.title: ליאו מסי ממשיך "להשתולל": צמד, 936 שערי קריירה ועוד שיא MLS

paragraphs: At the age of 39, Lionel Messi continues to defy expectations, proving that his legendary career is far from over. In a recent 3-1 victory for Inter Miami against Atlanta United, the Argentine superstar delivered a masterclass, scoring two goals and further cementing his dominance in Major League Soccer. With this performance, Messi has brought his total career tally to 936 goals, leaving him just 64 shy of the elusive 1,000-goal milestone.

Inter Miami’s head coach, Cristian "Kily" González, expressed profound admiration for his star player. "He never ceases to amaze the world," González remarked. "It is difficult to believe that at 39, he is still performing at this level. What pleases me most is seeing him genuinely happy; when he is happy, he gives everything he has." González remains optimistic about Messi’s potential to reach the 1,000-goal mark, noting that the forward thrives on challenges and has already conquered almost everything else in the sport. He even suggested that Messi might reach this historic figure before Cristiano Ronaldo.

Messi’s impact on the pitch was undeniable. After Germán Berterame opened the scoring for Miami in the 45th minute, Messi took control in the second half. In the 56th minute, he cut inside from the right flank, exchanged passes with Berterame, and finished with a precise left-footed strike against goalkeeper Lucas Hoyos. Four minutes later, he doubled his tally following a swift counter-attack initiated by Luis Suárez. Beyond his scoring prowess, Messi is currently tied with Son Heung-min for the most assists in the league, with 15. This achievement makes him the first player in MLS history to record at least 15 assists in three consecutive seasons. Furthermore, he has now been involved in a goal for 13 consecutive matches, matching the second-longest streak of his professional career.

This match also marked a return to the Mercedes-Benz Stadium, a venue that holds significant memories for the Argentine. It was his first appearance there since the 2026 World Cup semi-final in July, where he provided two crucial late assists to help Argentina defeat England. Since retiring from international duty following a friendly against Benin earlier this month, Messi has been in blistering form, netting four goals in three matches for Inter Miami. As the team prepares for the playoffs, having already secured their spot with a third consecutive win, the focus remains on whether their talisman can continue this historic run toward the 1,000-goal target. With his current momentum, many observers believe that reaching such a monumental figure is not only possible but likely for a player who continues to redefine the limits of professional football.

facts.fact: Lionel Messi scored two goals in Inter Miami's 3-1 victory over Atlanta United.
Messi has 25 goals in the MLS this season.
Messi is the first player in MLS history to record 15 assists in three consecutive seasons.
Inter Miami coach Cristian 'Kily' González believes Messi can reach 1,000 career goals.
